title_zh: 以单人入住身份询问套房报价

scenario.label_zh: 套房单人入住的报价资料询问
scenario.goal_zh: 明确单人入住与独立工作空间需求并请求书面报价

context_zh: 虚构酒店沟通练习：旅客 Quinn 向预订员 May 询问套房，没有完成预订或支付。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Quinn
sentences.text: I’ll be the sole occupant, but I need a separate space to work. Would a suite have a living area as well as a bedroom?

sentences.speaker: May
sentences.text: Our courtyard suite does. Are you asking about three nights next month?

sentences.speaker: Quinn
sentences.text: Yes, the dates in my inquiry. Could you send a written quote showing the room charge and any breakfast cost separately?

sentences.speaker: May
sentences.text: Certainly. I’ll prepare that quote for those dates, subject to availability when you decide.

sentences.speaker: Quinn
sentences.text: Thank you. I’ll review it before making a booking.
